text:
Aisha M: Heads-up 1: we need a marketplace private-offer pattern that supports an escrow-style commit release for SI-led deployments. aim: reduce up-front discounting but keep renewal momentum. any sharp edges?
Luis V: Love the escrow idea. practical ask: how do we calculate the release schedule? monthly usage %, or milestone certificates from the SI?
Nate C: Prefer usage-linked schedule. milestones are noisy and slow. propose a tiered release: 25% after first production inference, 25% after hitting 30% of forecasted tokens in 60 days, remainder over next 3 months.
Aisha M: That sounds workable. we should also include a refundable holdback in case of churn at renewal (e.g., 10% holdback released at 90-day renewal). prevents customers from gaming short pilots.
Luis V: We need to map this into marketplace private-offer mechanics per cloud. AWS supports "custom billing attributes" in some flows, but others need the credit attached to SKU lines. PartnerOps Bot: I can enumerate marketplace constraints by provider.
PartnerOps Bot: Posting provider matrix to DM in 2m. (aws: partial credit attach, gcp: invoice-level credit only, azure: supports line-level adjustments for marketplace private offers)
Nate C: Ops constraint noted. For the math, draft formula: discount_release(amount, step) = min(amount_remaining, floor(usage_percentage/step_size) * step_chunk). example in pseudo: 
```
total_credit = commit_value * initial_discount_pct
step_chunk = total_credit / 4
released = step_chunk * floor(actual_usage_pct / 25)
```
This yields granular releases as usage crosses 25% buckets.
Aisha M: Good. finance needs to sign off on effective ARR impact. Finance Bot: run quick sim for a $500k commit at 20% initial discount, usage curve 30/60/90/120 days.
Finance Bot: Sim results (summary):
- total_credit = $100,000
- release schedule (by bucket): $25k at prod deploy, $25k at 30% usage, $25k at 60% usage, $25k at 100% usage
- project ARR impact: insured retention uplift ~+6% in conservative case
Luis V: Can we add an SI kicker (extra 5% credit) if SI enables two production routes or deploys infra automation? encourages real work. but cap total credits at 30% of commit.
Nate C: Agree on cap. Also add a renewal grace window: if customer drops to tier 2 at renewal, allow a 30-day remediation period where SI can reinstate usage and salvage the renewal discount.
Aisha M: Action items:
- PartnerOps Bot: provider credit capability matrix (due EOD)
- Nate: spec release math + sample calculations for 3 customer profiles (small, mid, enterprise) (due 48h)
- Finance Bot: sensitivity sims for 5 usage curves (due 72h)
- Luis: draft SI kicker criteria & examples (due 48h)
Luis V: I'll draft the SI language: "Kicker credits payable on demonstrated multi-route production and automation runbook delivery". short and sales-friendly. :memo:
Aisha M: If everyone ok, I'll assemble the private-offer template with escrow annex and circulate Monday. no strong objections?
Nate C: none from eng.
Luis V: all good from partnerships.
PartnerOps Bot: Matrix delivered to DM (AWS/GCP/Azure rows). :white_check_mark:
